GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat touch better Mid Field 3 Wide 4 Lengths 1000m, got moving into the race With Cover from the 500m, looked winning chance when balanced-up behind Leader Straightening Up but run peaked last 200m and did not finish race off well enough # run peaked 200m
Bit Slow Out from a Wide draw. Settled Down 3 Wide No Cover 6th 5 Lengths @ 600m. all Clear Straightening Up . Just Held Ground # wide/no run on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide without cover; inconvenienced and carried wider near home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide by the 900m, held together much same to turn 3 Lengths Two Wide , hooked Wide Straightening Up and Dropped Out in Straight # weakened badly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Trainer reported arthroscopic procedure to right knee. Has since trialled.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 8l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off all clear, worked home ok but never a threat # back/home ok

Jumped Ok eased Inside Mid Field 5-6l. off rail and between runners to 600m then Hard Ridden Turn . Held Up into Straight between runners before Battled On Well and Made Some Ground behind them last 200m. no threat # margin bit unfair
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 400m had to be steadied when crowded.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well . Settled Down Two Wide 5th 5 Lengths @ 1000m. fanned very Wide to Best Going Straightening Up . Kept Finding line, witihn half a length of 2nd # finished off ok

Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside Settled Down rear 3 Wide 8 Lengths Soon After let stride to be Just Off Mid-Field 3 Wide with a trail 5 Lengths , Under Pressure Turning for home Four Wide 6th x 200m, kept trying without threatening - # had no favours

Jumped okay, Eased and taken across settling down 5.5 Lengths Two Wide , Hooked Out 3 Wide at 800m and circled forward to 3 Wide joint Lead at the 650m, edged out to Lead Two Wide by a head turning, raced head'n'head until overtaken by the winner at the 50m # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From the outside barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages. Near the 150m was bumped. Approaching the 800m was shifted wider to improve into a position outside the lead.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 5th 3 Wide 3-4 Lengths Out On A Limb improved 4th x 800 2 Lengths , Hard Ridden 400 Kept Trying - # 3 wide, gave all
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and bumped. Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained Settled Down 6th Inside 6 Lengths and Inside winner Good Pace on, remained Inside 1st to Straightening Up both now Hard Ridden , quickened from 100 and had its chance - # ran on with 1st
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up from the 300m until passing the 200m where it made contact with another rnr on two occasions when improving into a run.
